run_LvisEvaluator: run LVIS evaluation on object detection predictions using LvisEvaluator with bbox and segm iou types
run_LVISEval: run LVIS evaluation by creating an LVISEval instance with ground truth and detection results then calling run
create_LVISResults: create LVISResults from a list of detection dicts with bbox or segmentation and score fields
prepare_LvisEvaluator_segmentation: prepare LVIS segmentation results from predictions dict containing scores, labels, and masks tensors
convert_convert_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format using torch tensor operations
